name: Chaos Method
summary:
Embrace the chaos. An experimental game exploring a variety of VR control schemes. The game is designed for VR first-timers and is made with extremely accessible controls to allow everyone to join the fun.

From precision chopping to city-smashing mayhem, every game offers a new way to play and learn. Short, accessible, and designed for VR newcomers, not veterans.

Features:

• Built for VR first-timers

• Varied controls teach core VR mechanics

• Quick sessions (minutes, not hours)

• Chaotic, destructive
